answer_format: End your reply with a final line that contains \boxed{<answer>}.

rules.normalisation: hotpot_evaluate_v1.py normalize_answer: lower case; characters of string.punctuation removed; \b(a|an|the)\b replaced by a space; white space collapsed
rules.f1: token F1 of the normalised strings; 0 when either normalises to yes, no or noanswer and they differ; 0 when no token is shared
rules.placeholder: src/content_scoring.is_placeholder (content/1.5.0): a box is a placeholder when its content (wrappers, bold and '$' removed, LaTeX spacing read as blanks, whitespace collapsed, quotes and a final period dropped, case folded) is empty; or a slot name bare (^(?:(?:the|your|my|final|correct|chosen)\s+)*(?:answer|number)(?:\s+(?:here|goes\s+here|will\s+be\s+here|letter|number|text))?$); or wholly in angle brackets a slot name (^(?:(?:the|your|my|final|correct|chosen)\s+)*(?:answer|number|letter|option|choice|value|result|solution)(?:\s+(?:here|goes\s+here|will\s+be\s+here|letter|number|text))?$). It is skipped as the answer box and removed from the text before the reading without a box, as is a brace-less copy. An option named with its letter ('<Option A>', ^(?:option|choice|letter)\s*(?:\(\s*([a-z])\s*\)|([a-z]))$) is not a placeholder (content/1.5.0): it is read as that letter.; or a content that, unwrapped and cleaned, normalises to '' or 'answer'
rules.spacing: LaTeX spacing commands (a backslash before a blank, \, \; \: \!, \quad, \qquad, '~') are read as blanks in a box's content and in the placeholder rule; a thin space between digit groups (a digit, an optional comma, the command, three digits) is read as a thousands comma
rules.clean: LaTeX spacing read as blanks, then a leading copied '<answer>' (optional '-' or ':') removed, then a leading answer cue (src/content_scoring.strip_answer_prefix), then angle brackets around the whole content, then the cue once more
rules.other_box: a box written with angle brackets in place of its braces (the backslash optional) or as a tag (<boxed>X</boxed>, the closing '>' optional), on one line and outside every complete \boxed{...}, is a box holding X; it is a placeholder when X, or X in angle brackets, is one; boxes of both kinds are taken in the order of their openings, and the last that is not a placeholder is read; a placeholder of either form is removed from the text before the reading without a box
rules.content: the last box that is not a placeholder, complete boxes and boxes written with other brackets taken in the order of their openings; else, on the text with every placeholder box (with or without its backslash) and every brace-less placeholder copy removed: a final unclosed box when there is no complete box at all; else the rest of the line after the last answer cue; else the last non-empty line, read inside its first complete backslash-less box when it holds one; each unwrapped and cleaned; None for an empty output
rules.unchanged: strict, lenient and compliance stay those of hotpot-boxed/1.0.0
